t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ndime kamboni mwami Leza wangu, kuti wakandilengela kuti nkuzibe alimwi nkukombe. Ndazumina cino ciindi kuti ndimuteteete webo ndiwe singuzu, mebo ndimucete pele webo ulimuvubi. Kunyina umbi Leza zunze kwako ndiwe mugwasyi mumapenzi esu, ulapona mukuyanda kwako.
